head: 4f7f59718e29240225ab65a3f6d3ab6915e97057
summary: block_text and label_block_text quote the raw command (up to 100 characters) in the block reason, and log_decision redacts only the command field, not the reason, so a credential typed inline in a blocked production command (an environment assignment of a token before a deploy command) is written verbatim to the committed evidence/hook-log.jsonl.
